1436-3488-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-3488-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Katsumasa.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1315-5929-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
1315-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 3.

When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability
Repeat.

Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Armor Wars.
Repeat.

Gain life.

Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.

Repeat.

Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1796-4484-4871-5643-6797.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
1796-4484-4871-5643-6797.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Phantom Train abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
1796-4484-4871-5643-6797.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

3951-4452-5703-6798.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-4452-5703-6798.description:

When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

1308-2038-4499.description:

When Kozilek's Predator enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.

Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

282-505-1558-3263.notablePrerequisites:
Delina does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
You have at least four creature cards in your graveyard.
282-505-1558-3263.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker.
Delina triggers, creating at least one nonlegendary token copy of Izoni with haste.
When the Izoni token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Izoni token and the Insect tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

The creature dies, triggering Basri's Lieutenant's second ability, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token.
When the Knight enters the battlefield, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on the Knight.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

751-3091-4067.notablePrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can tap to produce at least {U}.

Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Defiler of Dreams triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Shrieking Drake, causing it to enter the battlefield, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping the mana-producing permanent from step 1.
Repeat.

1494-2334-4802.notablePrerequisites: Master Biomancer has power 5 or greater.
1494-2334-4802.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Sage of Hours and causing it to enter the battlefield with five or more +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Soulherder's first ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
